verdict.rationale: Synctera documents its own scheduling capability, "Create and manage scheduled payments for customers." That covers scheduled payment operations within its banking domain, but there is no evidence of general job or workflow scheduling, and the item does not explicitly say the schedules can recur. Missing for 10: explicit recurring schedule definitions (intervals or cron-like rules), general workflow or job scheduling beyond payments, in-depth docs on scheduled-payment configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
